newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror to sell Harry Abrams unit.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror to sell Harry Abrams unit.

text.p: Times Mirror said Monday it had signed a letter of intent to sell its artbook publisher Harry N. Abrams Inc to Groupe Latingy, the major French art and illustrated book publisher.
The company did not disclose the terms of the deal apart from saying that it will hold a minority stake in Latingy.

Last fall, Times Mirror announced its decision to sell Harry N. Abrams as part of a strategy to focus on its core newspapers, professional information and magazine businesses. The company publishes the Los Angeles Times, Newsday, The Baltimore Sun and other newspapers.
